method: Keep twelve source base frames and the audited short6bracket/5insert/1cog. Derive two different six-upper-frame orientation multisets: three turned frames in the first row, then two turned plus one unturned (count5) or three turned(count6). Retain the one source-derived6.75degree cog phase and axis pitch without a sweep. Count6 uses4x2 cog sites above the highest roof plus1x6 sites right of the roof starting above the base, giving14sites. Count5 uses3x2 above highest roof,1x3 in the fourth column above the lower unturned frame, and1x6 right of the second roof row, giving15sites; check every14-of15 subset. Source dimensions/gap/radius determine coordinates, not saved optimized states. Preserve all failures without phase/pitch adjustments. These fixed-source variants do not resume a closed optimizer. Broader historical all-frame models exist; neither class is claimed globally untested.
